category: olympiad-level math (short prompt; very long reasoning output)

prompt_len: Issue text: mean 313, median 221, p90 677, max 1,604 tokens (sample n=100) [verified]. Static agent prefix: SWE-agent (2024) system+demo 5,876 tokens; OpenHands system prompt ~1.2k (+ tool schemas, not in logs); RAG setting: BM25 13K/27K/40K contexts [verified].

turns: multi-step agent loop: SWE-agent+Claude-3.5-Sonnet (Jun 2024) mean 34 / median 29 / max 78 LLM calls; SWE-agent 1.0+Claude-4-Sonnet (May 2025) mean 56 / median 54 / max 100; OpenHands+Claude-4-Sonnet mean 69 / median 60 / p90 110 / max 206 [verified, samples of 100/40/100 S3 trajectories].
context_growth: Append-only growth with tool observations. Final context: SWE-agent+C3.5 mean 34k (median 28k, max 99k); SWE-agent1.0+C4 mean 46k (median 40k, max 95k); OpenHands+C4 mean 48k (median 45k, p90 72k, max 104k) tokens. Median per-call context ~21-25k. Sum of per-call prompt lengths (prefill without prefix caching): 1.3M (SWE-agent1.0) - 2.0M (OpenHands) tokens per instance, i.e., ~28-37x the final context; SWE-agent+C3.5 logged 528k cumulative input tokens (avg 14.4k/call). Per observation: median 159-416 tokens, mean ~0.5-0.7k, max >200k (huge file/grep dumps) [verified].

kv_profile: agentic: shared static prefix (1-6k) + append-only growth to 30-100k; 30-200 prefill-heavy calls per task
